question: Which mythic act of the goddess is commemorated in this salutation to Kāmeśvarī?
premises: The goddess is addressed in relation to the slaying of Mahiṣāsura.
inference: Kāmeśvarī is saluted as the goddess who slew Mahiṣāsura.
plain_english: O goddess who slew the buffalo demon, O Kāmeśvarī, obeisance to you.
